Unsent Letters: a live performance
With actors Harriet Walter, Tuppence Middleton, Nina Toussaint White and others; author
Caroline Atkins and moderator Hannah Maclnnes.

Harriet Walter and Tuppence Middleton are just two of the stars joining us to read the letters left unsent by
history's greatest figures - from Beethoven to Van Gogh, Virginia Woolf to Iris Murdoch, George Ill to JFK.
Some were written out of an alcoholic haze, others bashed out by writers too hot-tempered to check either
the sense or the spelling. Many provoked trouble or revealed too much. One may have started a nuclear
war.

Join us for a rich pageantry of human drama, brought to life by the stars of stage and screen.
